answer: A compute heartbeat with beacon spot-checks stops fake identities. Each agent emits a proof-of-work pulse per epoch, proving one machine each; the pulses form a river no faker can forge. A beacon samples 5% each epoch and demands a reply in 10 minutes; a missed pulse or failed check burns the $30 deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs $30,000 plus 1,000 machines; an honest agent pays $30 once. Like an opal, no two heartbeats share a signature.
